english.note: Use 扮 in casual speech when someone changes their appearance or acts as another person, especially by taking on a role or identity.

exampleSentences.english: They disguise themselves as students to get into the venue.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 baan6 hok6 saang1 wan6 jap6 wui6 coeng4

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for pretending to be another person, especially without stressing fraud.

exampleSentences.english: They always impersonate the teacher, making the whole class laugh.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日扮老師，搞到全班笑晒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 lou5 si1 gaau2 dou3 cyun4 baan1 siu3 saai3

english.note: Use this when imitating a person's manner, voice, or behavior, often with a playful or mocking implication.

exampleSentences.english: You always imitate the way I talk!
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 sing4 jat6 baan6 ngo5 gong2 je5 gaa3 wo3
